buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address AGM, Ward-34, Valves/Stores, BHEL, Trichy-620014 . 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 5. Generic Without prejudice to Buyer’s right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy available to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller, if:

i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller. 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 7. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): By Supplier's QC at their Works Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: By BHEL QC at BHEL Stors 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses This is a Nil Technical Deviation Tender Offers shall be evaluated only from such sellers, who have provided valid documents as called for in Pre-Qualification Requirement(PQR) along with the bid. The PQR is available at “Buyer added Bid S pecific Additional Scope of Work” in the bid document. BHEL reserves the right to consider/Not-consider the offers based on the adequacy and evaluation of docu ments submitted. All Commercial terms are non- negotiable. Any document(s), in any form, submitted by the sel ler in this bid, which is not relevant or not requested by the buyer, indicating any deviation fr om commercial terms, will not be considered and the offer will be evaluated accordingly. 1. The below necessary supporting documents shall be attached under the following headers for smooth ev aluation of the offers. 2. Filled-in, signed & sealed “Scope of Supply” format – Annexure-A 3. Filled-in, signed & sealed “Schedule of Deviation” format – Annexure-B 4. Documents/records required as per PQR – Annexure-C 5. Filled-in, signed & sealed “Conflict of Interest” format in bidder’s letter pad– Annexure-D 6. Declaration Format in bidder’s letter pad – Annexure-E 7. Filled-in, signed & sealed Confirmations to Buyer Added Bid Specific Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC) 8. Applicable Annexures 1-7, 10, 11-14, in bidder’s letter pad, as per attached checklist 9. Endorsed applicable technical specifications (such as Drawing, TDC, Purchase Spec etc.,) 10. UDYAM Registration Certificate

11. signed & sealed GeM Bid Document Samples: In case of bagging orders, new Suppliers (those not supplied the items covered in this tender to BHEL, Tric hy against material group “CPFOF” shall necessarily submit 2 Nos. of each item ordered as sample(s) fro m the ordered PO quantities along with required quality documents within 8 weeks from date of PO for cle arance. Bulk dispatches shall be done only after sample clearance. Due delivery date extensions, to extent of time taken for clearance, shall be provided for bulk quantities only if samples are submitted within the s tipulated period. On-site assessment: BHEL reserves the right to conduct an on-site/ remote assessment (if required) for evaluation of qualified b idder after due intimation. Intimation of changes: Supplier shall duly inform BHEL about any changes to already existing location, company’s constitution, o wnership etc., and request BHEL along with applicable documents and/ or records for updating records afte r due review and evaluation (if necessary) for continuation of enlistment status with BHEL. Validity of certificates: As vendor registration requires QMS certification as minimum, the vendor/ bidder must ensure that their c ertifications remain valid throughout the contract duration or until they cease being a PMD vendor. Any ch anges, including renewals, loss of certifications, or modifications to qualifications, must be promptly notifie d to BHEL within 3 days, accompanied by the latest supporting documentation. Scheduled Delivery date: In general, the scheduled delivery date will be same in GeM contract and corresponding BHEL PO. Beyond the scheduled delivery date, even if the delivery date in GeM contract is extended for reasons pertaining t o GeM portal, only the delivery date mentioned in BHEL PO will stand valid for all reasons including calcula tion of LD, unless notified otherwise Collection of rejected items: Items rejected during receipt/ usage shall be collected by the supplier from time to time by producing appl icable credit note at BHEL Stores. Subsequently, replacements for rejected items and quantities shall be s upplied. Invoice submission: · As part of our strategy towards digital transformation, Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) has launch ed the Unified Supplier Portal: https://suvidha.bhel.in/suvidha/ · Suppliers can log in to the portal using their PAN number (please refer to the attached User Manual for gu idance). Through this portal, you can submit digitally signed invoices along with other requisite documents , as specified in the purchase order, for each dispatch. · Effective immediately, all digitally signed invoices (bearing a valid Class 3 Digital Signature) and related d ocuments must be uploaded on the portal for payment processing. Submission of hard copies of invoices is no longer required. Please note that the system will not accept invoices without a valid Class 3 Digital Sign ature. · However, as usual, duplicate invoice for transporter, packing slip, and delivery challan must be available with the transporter for gate entry into BHEL factory/stores premises. · Also, original MTCs, test reports, and other relevant technical documents as specified in the purchase ord er/tender must still be submitted in hard copy—either via courier or in person—before goods receipt, for q uality clearance. · In case of any doubt, kindly write to usdc@bhel.in, with a copy marked to the undersigned. Important Note: · "In respect of procurement of goods or services from Micro, Small and Medium enterprises (MSMEs), the s

ettlement of invoice shall be only through any of the TReDS platform (i.e., RXIL, Ml xchange, lnvoicemart, KReDX, C2FO), authorised by the Reserve Bank of India. Such MSME suppliers to select their preferred TRe DS platform before award of contract so that the data is captured in the Order /Contract database of the U nit. They also will have the option to change the TReDS platform from the drop down menu on SUVIDHA po rtal of BHEL, at the time of invoice submission. · Wherever the Trade Receivable is accepted by BHEL, the same shall be validated by the Unit on the respe ctive TReDS platform selected by the supplier. · The routing of invoices through the TReDS platform shall not be construed as mandating discounting of s uch invoices and the MSMEs supplier shall have the option to avail or not avail financing or discounting of i ts receivables on the TReDS platform. · In case discounting is not availed by the supplier on TReDS, the trade receivables will be paid through TR eDS as per the payment timelines indicated in the contract." . 9.
